card: Edit the FIRST image (the two adults) into the exact simpler round picture-book drawing style of reference images 2, 3 and 4. Preserve Robert on the left in ochre cardigan with short side-part brown hair and a plain closed notebook, Sophie on the right with auburn bob, teal blouse and coral skirt; preserve them talking and looking towards each other. Make heads rounder and larger, simple dot/arc eyes and small rounded noses, bold clean dark-brown outlines, soft flat watercolor fills, much LESS realistic anatomical shading and fabric detail, matching the three reference cards. Two adults with charming stylized proportions, not children. Medium closeup including every hand and elbow, small round table and plant behind. Both people and every hand must fit with generous transparent margins; lower torso edges can softly fade BELOW the hands, never cut or fade fingers. Remove objects at the very edges. No letters, text, stars or card frame. Output true transparent background.
robert: Use this illustration as the exact character and drawing-style reference. Make a new FULL BODY stage illustration of the SAME Robert and Sophie, on a truly transparent 1024x1024 square canvas. Keep the round heads, simple dark oval eyes, clean thick brown contours, same brown hair, Robert's ochre cardigan and ivory shirt with blue-gray long trousers, Sophie's auburn bob, teal blouse and coral skirt. Two stylized adults standing at the SAME scale facing one another: Robert on left looks RIGHT at Sophie, right hand gently open while asking; Sophie on right looks LEFT at him and listens, hands naturally at her sides. Both wear brown shoes. No background, no table, no plant, no notebook, no extra props, no text, no occupational tools. Both entire bodies from hair to fingertips to shoes must be fully drawn, with a generous transparent outer margin above, below, left and right. Leave a modest clear gap between the two bodies. Heads roughly one quarter of full figure height. Preserve charming adult identity, avoid realistic facial anatomy. This is a two-person reusable stage cast, not a sprite sheet. No labels.
sophie: Edit the attached two-person full-body stage illustration. Preserve exactly the same Robert on the left and Sophie on the right, same heads, hair, adult identities, clothing, proportions, shoes, scale, positions, transparent canvas and generous outer margins. Change ONLY their conversational gestures: Robert now listens with his open hand lowered naturally beside his body; Sophie speaks, raising her left-side hand (the hand nearer Robert) with an open friendly palm towards him. They continue looking at each other; Robert looks right and Sophie looks left. Keep every hand, finger, elbow, hair and shoe wholly inside the image. Do not crop or add text, props, backgrounds or shadows. True transparency.
method: Built-in image_gen; format conversion by sharp, no crop.
